sources.title: What were the first birds like?
sources.notes: Archaeopteryx bony tail, teeth and wing claws; bird-lineage concepts and uncertainty in the bird/non-bird boundary. Original inventory verification: search-result. This does not assert a new full source reading.

sources.title: Direct evidence of frugivory in the Mesozoic bird Longipteryx contradicts morphological proxies for diet
sources.notes: Primary-paper summary documents seed ingesta; no fishing or insect-catching scenario is commissioned.

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired art with basic recognizable anatomy. Not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact locomotion, life-history, coexistence or animation-readiness claim.

nominal_scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

artistic_choices: Suggested palette: olive-green, cream and muted ochre
Nominal size, proportions, pose, missing fine parts and simplified detail are artistic.
Tiny subjects need close placement or an explicit creative display-scale choice; do not promise readability from a distant island camera.
Opaque or economical portable materials are preferred. Fine translucent/vein/feather detail is optional when it does not survive normal viewing.

description.en: Original static stylized-inspired longipteryx; evidence-informed teaching art, not a strict scientific reconstruction.
description.zh: longipteryx 原创静态风格化教学美术；参考基本形态，并非严格科考复原。

author: Leon Made This / s010s
